title: Mamdani Taps His Social Media Charm on Behalf of Hochul, a Crucial Ally
summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s first campaign video for Gov. Kathy Hochul, in which he attacks her Republican rival, Bruce Blakeman, has some of the mayor’s hallmark appeal, but a bit less pizazz.
